## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: docs/guides/memory-conventions.md documents the four prefixes with allowed...

The system SHALL ensure that docs/guides/memory-conventions.md documents the four prefixes with allowed values and an example entry carrying all four.

#### Scenario: docs/guides/memory-conventions.md documents the four prefixes with allowed...

WHEN `extend-capability-gap-tag-schema-with-evidence-prefixes` is implemented
THEN docs/guides/memory-conventions.md documents the four prefixes with allowed values and an example entry carrying all four.

### Requirement: A memory entry written by collect-transcripts with --enable carries...

The system SHALL ensure that a memory entry written by collect-transcripts with --enable carries instruction:, polarity:, class:, and domain: tags when the finding is anchored to an instruction, and a test asserts the tag set.

#### Scenario: A memory entry written by collect-transcripts with --enable carries...

WHEN `extend-capability-gap-tag-schema-with-evidence-prefixes` is implemented
THEN A memory entry written by collect-transcripts with --enable carries instruction:, polarity:, class:, and domain: tags when the finding is anchored to an instruction, and a test asserts the tag set.

### Requirement: Queries by prefix (from ri-05) return entries filtered by polarity:negative...

The system SHALL ensure that queries by prefix (from ri-05) return entries filtered by polarity:negative and class:harm.

#### Scenario: Queries by prefix (from ri-05) return entries filtered by polarity:negative...

WHEN `extend-capability-gap-tag-schema-with-evidence-prefixes` is implemented
THEN Queries by prefix (from ri-05) return entries filtered by polarity:negative and class:harm.
